## Classes

### `class DesignTokens`

DesignTokens - Design system token management. Token management pattern: - Centralized token system for Plauna styling - Manages spacing, typography, color, motion, borderRadius, shadows, zIndex - Observer pattern for token change notifications - Caching for performance optimization - Deep merge strategy for token inheritance Architecture: - tokens: Merged token object (defaults + custom) - observers: Set of callback functions - cache: Map of cached token lookups

| `constructor` | `constructor(customTokens = {})` |  |
| `get` | `get(path, defaultValue = undefined)` | Get a token value by path. Token access pattern: - Supports dot notation (e.g., 'spacing.md') - Returns cached value if available - Falls back to defaultValue if token not found - Caches result for subsequent lookups |
| `set` | `set(path, value)` | Set a token value by path. Token mutation pattern: - Sets token value using dot notation - Clears cache to invalidate stale values - Notifies observers of token change - Provides old value for comparison |

## Notes & Examples

### App & widget lifecycle

Plauna apps and widgets follow a **mount → update → unmount** lifecycle; services (storage, command bus, theming) are *injected* rather than imported, so the same widget runs in the editor, the OS shell, and standalone.

**See also:** [Plauna Architecture](/plauna/architecture.md) · [Plauna Overview](/plauna/overview.md)

### App & widget lifecycle

Plauna apps and widgets follow a **mount → update → unmount** lifecycle; services (storage, command bus, theming) are *injected* rather than imported, so the same widget runs in the editor, the OS shell, and standalone.

**Example: Widget with full lifecycle**
```js
import { Widget } from 'plauna/core/Widget.js';
import { useStorage, useCommands } from 'plauna/hooks.js';

class CounterWidget extends Widget {
  mount(container, services) {
    // Inject dependencies
    this.storage = useStorage(services);
    this.commands = useCommands(services);
    
    this.el = document.createElement('div');
    this.count = this.storage.get('count', 0);
    this.render();
    container.appendChild(this.el);
    
    // Register commands
    this.commands.register('counter:reset', () => {
      this.count = 0;
      this.render();
    });
  }
  
  update(props) {
    if (props.increment) this.count++;
    this.render();
  }
  
  render() {
    this.el.textContent = `Count: ${this.count}`;
    this.storage.set('count', this.count);
  }
  
  unmount() {
    this.commands.unregister('counter:reset');
    this.el.remove();
  }
}
```

**See also:** [Plauna Architecture](/plauna/architecture.md) · [Plauna Overview](/plauna/overview.md)
